s.H5715: feminine of 5707; testimony KJV: testimony, witness.

s.H5717: from 5716 and 410; ornament of God; Adiel, the name of three Israelites KJV: Adiel.
s.H5718: or עֲדָיָהוּ; from 5710 and 3050; Jah has adorned; Adajah, the name of eight Israelites KJV: Adaiah.

s.H5728: or עֲדֶנָּה; from 5704 and 2004; till now KJV: yet.
s.H5729: from 5727; pleasure; Eden, a place in Mesopotamia KJV: Eden.
s.H5730: or (feminine) עֶדְנָה; from 5727; pleasure KJV: delicate, delight, pleasure. See also 1040.
s.H5731: the same as 5730 (masculine); Eden, the region of Adam's home KJV: Eden.
s.H5732: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of 5708; a set time; technically, a year KJV: time.
s.H5733: from 5727; pleasure; Adna, the name of two Israelites KJV: Adna.
s.H5734: from 5727; pleasure; Adnah, the name of two Israelites KJV: Adnah.
s.H5735: from 5712; festival; Adadah, a place in Palestine KJV: Adadah.
s.H5736: a primitive root; to be (causatively have) redundant KJV: be more, odd number, be (have) over (and above), overplus, remain.
s.H5737: a primitive root; to arrange, as a battle, a vineyard (to hoe); hence, to muster and so to miss (or find wanting) KJV: dig, fail, keep (rank), lack.
s.H5738: from 5737; an arrangement (i.e. drove); Eder, an Israelite KJV: Ader.
s.H5739: from 5737; an arrangement, i.e. muster (of animals) KJV: drove, flock, herd.
s.H5740: the same as 5739; Eder, the name of an Israelite and of two places in Palestine KJV: Edar, Eder.
s.H5741: from 5739 and 410; flock of God; Adriel, an Israelite KJV: Adriel.
s.H5742: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a lentil KJV: lentile.
s.H5743: a primitive root; to be dense or dark, i.e. to becloud KJV: cover with a cloud.
s.H5744: active participle of 5647; serving; Obed, the name of five Israelites KJV: Obed.
s.H5745: of foreign derivation; Obal, a son of Joktan KJV: Obal.
s.H5746: a primitive root; properly, to gyrate; but used only as a denominative from 5692, to bake (round cakes on the hearth) KJV: bake.
s.H5747: probably from 5746; round; Og, a king of Bashan KJV: Og.
s.H5748: or עֻגָּב; from 5689 in the original sense of breathing; a reed-instrument of music KJV: organ.
s.H5749: a primitive root; to duplicate or repeat; by implication, to protest, testify (as by reiteration); intensively, to encompass, restore (as a sort of reduplication) KJV: admonish, charge, earnestly, lift up, protest, call (take) to record, relieve, rob, solemnly, stand upright, testify, give warning, (bear, call to, give, take to) witness.
